scope: Explicit recovery of prepared requests after non-resumable browser network/server failure

baseline.failure: Expected one retained request; actual zero. Prepared native request was released.

change: Retain prepared request when original browser item is interrupted with explicit canResume=false and NETWORK_/SERVER_ error, unless fully received.
Expose existing confirmed restart/discard workflow for that state.
Recheck browser state before native commit; resumed original blocks restart.
User-canceled, blocked, resumable and capability-unknown browser items do not qualify.
limitations: Transaction APIs are mocked in regression tests; UI runs in isolated Edge with mocked messages.
Real browser crash/network failure qualification pending.
Does not recover lost bytes or guarantee expired one-use requests can be repeated.
Changes staged in source only; not installed or packaged. Full IDM parity remains incomplete.
